operations.content: RAG Assistant project: ~/projects/rag-assistant/. Uses DeepSeek API (deepseek-chat) for LLM command parsing, local Ollama (nomic-embed-text) for embeddings. API key via DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env var — NEVER commit to git. Config in config.yaml (no secrets).

RAG Assistant tech choices: FastAPI + uvicorn, ChromaDB (local), APScheduler for cron, Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS dark-theme web UI, Obsidian vault for notes, Handy.app for voice input. Russian-language interface.
